parts.title: The Final Broadcast of a Collapsing World — Part 1

series.summary: Inside the barricaded high school faculty lounge, Takashi, Rei, Saya, and the surviving students watch live television in stunned horror. Special news bulletins report that riot police in major metropolitan areas are being overwhelmed by assailants who are already biologically deceased. The broadcast escalates into global catastrophe: the American president flees the White House to an airborne command aircraft, contact with Moscow is completely lost, Beijing burns, and nuclear retaliation protocols are considered. Realizing that civilization has collapsed worldwide, the survivors realize no outside rescue is coming.

segments.voiceover_text: Emergency news broadcasts show riot police opening fire on advancing crowds. The terrified anchor screams the unthinkable truth on air: the attackers are already dead.
Studio broadcasters urge families to remain indoors. But television monitors behind the desk reveal cities engulfed in smoke as public order disintegrates.
In the faculty lounge, Takashi and Saya watch the screen in shock. Saya bitterly points out that government attempts to contain panic have failed completely.
Worldwide reports confirm world leaders are fleeing to airborne bunkers as global capitals fall dark. Trapped inside the school, can six students survive a fallen world?

parts.title: The Blindness of the Walking Dead — Part 2

series.summary: With outside help an impossibility, genius student Saya Takagi breaks down the terrifying science of the outbreak. Comparing it to the historical Black Death and Spanish Flu, she points out a grim deviation: unlike regular disease victims, these corpses reanimate and relentlessly hunt the living. Dismissing hopes that summer heat will decompose the bodies, Saya warns they will walk indefinitely. Takashi convinces the group to unite and escape toward the parking lot to find their families. Inspecting the hallway, Saya deduces a critical secret: the monsters cannot see and react purely to sound.

segments.voiceover_text: Saya compares the outbreak to the medieval plague, but notes the terrifying difference: ordinary victims stay dead, but these corpses rise and hunt the living.
Kohta hopes summer heat will decompose the bodies. Saya crushes that fragile hope: these creatures show no decay and will continue hunting indefinitely.
Takashi rallies the survivors to unite as one team. To find their families, they must break through the infested building and secure a getaway vehicle.
Observing the hallway, Saya reveals a critical weakness: the dead are blind and track prey purely by sound. But who will risk their life to test the theory?

parts.title: The Silent Breakout Through the Courtyard — Part 3

series.summary: Takashi steps forward to test Saya's auditory hypothesis, with kendo champion Saeko Busujima volunteering to stand at his side as vanguard. Creating a noise diversion down the hall, the group watches as the zombies shamble toward the sound, completely ignoring the quiet teenagers right beside them. With the theory proven, the group mounts a coordinated breakout. Takashi bludgeons through the corridor, Saeko slices with lethal sword strikes, and Kohta provides suppressing fire with his modified nail gun. Reaching the parking area, Nurse Shizuka starts the minibus engine just as screams ring out.

segments.voiceover_text: Takashi volunteers to test the sound hypothesis firsthand. Saeko steps up beside him, ready to lead the vanguard with her wooden sword.
They create a distraction down the hall. The zombies shuffle toward the noise, proving the theory: the monsters cannot see them in total silence.
The breakout begins. Saeko strikes with lethal precision while Kohta lays down cover fire with his nail gun, carving a bloody path toward the parking lot.
Nurse Shizuka fires up the minibus engine. But just as the doors open, terrified screams echo from the building. Who else is racing toward their only escape?

parts.title: The Cruel Betrayal in the Courtyard — Part 4

series.summary: The desperate screams belong to a second group of surviving students, led by teacher Koichi Shido. As they frantically dash across the zombie-swarmed courtyard toward the waiting bus, an injured student stumbles and falls, pleading desperately for his teacher's hand. Instead of helping, Shido flashes a chilling smile and kicks the helpless boy straight into the ravenous undead, declaring coldly that the weak do not deserve survival. While the horde devours the abandoned teenager, Shido scrambles safely aboard the minibus, immediately asserting his authority over Takashi's stunned group.

segments.voiceover_text: A second wave of students bursts into the yard, led by teacher Koichi Shido. They sprint frantically toward the waiting minibus.
When an injured student collapses, he begs for help. Shido smiles coldly and kicks the boy into the grasping horde, declaring the weak must be abandoned.
The zombies tear into the sacrificed student while Shido scrambles aboard. Takashi and Rei watch in pure disgust at their teacher's remorseless betrayal.
Shido assumes command of the cabin, claiming survival demands ruthless leadership. He glares at Takashi—what horrifying games will this sociopath play with the survivors?

parts.title: The Rise of a Tyrant on the Bus — Part 5

series.summary: Inside the speeding minibus, the traumatized students weep as the school vanishes in the distance. Capitalizing on their sheer terror, teacher Shido begins a cunning psychological campaign, preaching that obedience and absolute hierarchy are their only hope. Panicked students quickly fall under his spell, accepting him as their undisputed leader. But Rei Miyamoto refuses to bow down: she reveals that Shido corruptly sabotaged her academic career to spite her detective father. When Shido threatens to exile anyone who questions him, Rei demands to leave the bus, and Takashi refuses to let her go alone.

segments.voiceover_text: Inside the bus, shell-shocked students weep as the vehicle speeds away from the overrun school. Outside, black smoke billows across the ruined city.
Panicked students question the route, terrified of entering downtown. Shido seizes on their desperation, manipulating their terror to assert his own dominance.
Shido declares himself supreme commander of the survivors. But Rei trembles with rage, confronting the corrupt teacher who maliciously derailed her life before the outbreak.
Refusing to obey a tyrant, Rei demands to leave the bus. Takashi steps to her side to protect her. Are they about to be cast out into the zombie-filled streets?

parts.title: The Ruptured Road into the Apocalypse — Part 6

series.summary: Takashi and Rei exit the minibus, choosing the deadly perils of the outside world over Shido's insidious tyranny. Finding an abandoned motorcycle on the elevated expressway, Takashi prepares to navigate the congested roadways. Suddenly, a massive multi-vehicle explosion and collapsing wreckage trigger an overwhelming surge of zombies that cuts off the highway, permanently severing Takashi and Rei from the school bus. Standing united against the apocalyptic skyline of a burning metropolis, Takashi and Rei ignite the motorcycle engine, resolved to survive together no matter the cost.

segments.voiceover_text: Takashi and Rei step off the bus onto the desolate highway. Choosing independence over Shido's dictatorship, they prepare to make their way on foot.
Ahead on the bridge, a fiery multi-car pileup blocks the roadway. Swarms of ravenous undead surround the burning wreckage, cutting off the path forward.
Spotting an abandoned motorcycle, Takashi kicks it into gear with Rei holding tight. The collapsing highway crushes the gap, permanently severing them from the bus.
Under the glowing embers of the skyline, Takashi and Rei pause on the open highway. The civilized world has vanished, but together, they ride into the apocalypse.
